jobs.title: Sr. Staff Qualitative Product Researcher, Ads
jobs.description:
**About Pinterest:**

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we're on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other's unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It's Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we're looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we'll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Pinterest is looking for a Sr. Staff Qualitative Researcher to lead research in our highest-priority ads areas. We are looking for a seasoned researcher who can embed in complex, ambiguous problem spaces, uncover the advertiser and Pinner needs that matter most, and turn them into a clear learning agenda. In this role you'll bring deep qual and mixed methods experience (as needed) to design, execute and communicate strategic research to senior stakeholders in the Ads org and beyond. You'll shape strategy by partnering with Product, Design, and Engineering and presenting insights and written POVs directly to senior leadership. You'll also help us decide where sustained research investment is needed, set direction for large cross-team research efforts, and mentor other researchers to raise the bar for qualitative craft. In this role, you'll have ownership of a broad problem space, autonomy to set and execute your research agenda, and real influence over the ads roadmap and the holistic Pinner experience.

  

**What you'll do:**

* **Lead high-impact qualitative research in our most strategic ads areas**: Embed in one or two high-priority problem spaces, such as Ads Integrity, and own the full research cycle from discovery through execution, delivery, and influence on product decisions.

* **Choose the right method for the question:** Plan, field, and synthesize research using the full range of qualitative methods, and partner with Data Science and quantitative researchers on mixed-methods studies that combine depth with scale.
* **Influence strategy and roadmap**: Partner with PMs and Designers to deliver informed, actionable recommendations, and communicate insights directly to leadership to help shape product direction. Author written POVs and cross-study syntheses that connect findings into a bigger picture.
* **Assess where sustained research investment is needed:** Evaluate whether an area warrants a long-term research presence, and make the case to leadership for where to invest.
* **Use AI to amplify your craft:**. Bring creativity to how you apply AI tools to research workflows and to how you land learnings, making cross-functional collaboration faster and more effective.
* **Provide vision and direction for large collaborative efforts:** Lead cross-team research initiatives across the ads organization (and as needed across ads and consumer orgs), setting direction and aligning partners around a shared point of view.
* Mentor and raise the bar: Coach and develop other researchers, and elevate qualitative craft across the team.

  

**What we're looking for:**

* Minimum 7 years of experience in qualitative or mixed-methods user research, with a track record of leading research at a staff or senior staff level in a product organization, ideally in ads, marketplaces, or B2B/B2C platforms.
* Deep expertise across the qualitative toolkit. Fluency in interviews, ethnography, diary studies, usability testing, concept testing, and other methods, with sound judgment about which approach best fits the question, timeline, and decision at hand.
* Experience in mixed-methods research. Demonstrated success partnering with Data Science and quantitative UX Research to combine qualitative depth with quantitative scale, and to triangulate findings across data sources.
* Demonstrated ability to influence product strategy and roadmap supported by strong storytelling and recommendations that can drive action
* Strong executive communication skills and comfort presenting insights, written POVs, and recommendations to senior leaders (Sr. Directors +) and cross-functional partners, and tailoring the message to the audience.

jobs.title: Robotics Research Scientist (San Francisco, CA)
jobs.description:
### **About Tutor**

We believe robots are the biggest lever we have to making the physical world a better, more affordable place. But robots are a rounding error in our society: nearly nine out of ten American factories and warehouses don’t even have a single robot, and robots have yet to make their way into our homes or places of business.

Tutor Intelligence is changing that.

Tutor is a robotics research and deployment company, building generally capable robot hardware and artificial intelligence to enable robots to go where no robots have gone before. Sonny is a semi-humanoid robot with frontier dexterity approaching the human form. Cassie does back-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for businesses from family-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. Tutor robots are manufactured at scale and operate as a network, combining the whole fleet’s learned experience to train ever more capable robot artificial intelligence.

Founded at MIT and headquartered in Watertown, MA, our team is full stack: we design and manufacture robot hardware, train our own models, work directly with the smallest and largest end-customers, and maintain our fleet across the United States. We’re a team of researchers, engineers, technicians, operators, and sellers who love building things and solving hard problems.

Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world.

### **The Role**

Are you tired of writing incremental code for massive CRUD web-apps? Do you want to build systems from the ground up that effect change in the physical world, not just the digital one? At Tutor, we are motivated by ***atoms not electrons***: every line of code you write has a real world impact at the foundation of our global economy, solving the core technical problems to evolve humanity and society to the next level.

Tutor Intelligence builds software to enable ordinary robots to achieve extraordinary things. As a research scientist, your work lies at the center of this challenge, building the AI algorithms and systems that drive novel capabilities in the lab and in the field.

At the core, we are looking for motivated and curious individuals who have exceptionally strong programming fundamentals. Experience in specific technical stacks or with robotics/ML are helpful but not requirements: whatever shape your skill set is, Tutor engineers and researchers shape their own roles to best tackle the frontier of robotics development.

### **Requirements**

* Exceptionally strong programming skills and comfort in one or more programming languages
* Natural collaborator, excited to work closely around a whiteboard in a team setting
* Excited by the future full of robots and a reshaped physical economy
* Not afraid to step foot in a factory or a warehouse

### **Nice to haves (zero or more)**

* Advanced proficiency with Python and/or Typescript + React
* Experience with robot arms / manipulation
* Experience with motion planning and robot optimization
* Experience with perception or computer vision (deep or classical)
* Experience with infra and devtools (systemd, Docker, Kubernetes)
* Experience with hardware / software integration

### **Why Tutor?**

Whether you’re designing robots, closing deals, running deployments, or creating the processes that help us scale, your work doesn’t sit on a shelf. It shows up on real production floors, making physical work safer and more affordable.

Our team of 160+ is driven by curiosity and a genuine love of building. Everyone here takes real ownership, learns fast, and holds a high bar while having each other’s backs. If you love hard problems and creating things that didn’t exist before, you’ll fit right in.

### **Benefits**

We take care of our team so they can do their best work. At Tutor, you’ll get:

* Fully employer-covered health insurance, so you’re protected without the premium.
* A managed 401(k) to help you plan for the future.
* Generous time off: unlimited PTO and all federal holidays off for full-time salaried employees, and 16+ days of accrued paid time off plus 1.5x pay on federal holidays for hourly employees.
* Regular in-office meals and team social events throughout the year.

As Tutor grows, so will our benefits. We’re continuing to invest in ways to support our team at work and beyond.

Tutor Intelligence is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

Epia Neuro is a neural technology company developing intent-driven systems designed to restore function and independence for people living with neurological conditions. Its platform integrates implantable neural interfaces, adaptive algorithms, and assistive devices to translate neural intent into real-world action. The company's initial focus is stroke-related motor impairment, with expansion into cognitive decline and other neurological disorders.

**The Role**
------------

We are generating neural and behavioral data at an increasing pace, across preclinical and early human research studies, with clinical studies ahead. We are looking for a neural data scientist to turn that data into rigorous answers. This ranges from characterizing signal quality and decoding performance to exploring what else our data can tell us, such as which movements and behaviors we can extract and decode. You will design and carry out the analyses and build the analysis workflows that let us do this reliably as our data grows.

This is a hands-on, individual contributor data scientist role on our Research team, reporting to the Director of Research. You will work alongside the scientists running our studies, and your work will shape study design, inform our decoding approaches, and contribute to publications. You will also partner closely with our Software team, which owns production code and the software infrastructure used in our studies.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own the analysis of our research studies end to end, from analysis strategy and statistical design through figures, readouts, and publications.
* Characterize and validate the in vivo recording performance of our neural interface (signal quality, noise, artifacts, and stability), and establish the preprocessing and quality control that downstream analyses depend on.
* Develop and evaluate decoding models that relate neural activity to behavior, including those used in closed-loop study sessions.
* Explore neural and behavioral data, including pose estimation and kinematics, to identify new variables and questions worth pursuing.
* Build reproducible analysis pipelines and help define data standards across studies.
* Work closely with study scientists to shape analysis plans and study design, communicate findings clearly to scientists, engineers, and leadership, and partner with our Software team to hand off research-grade methods and code.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* PhD in neuroscience, neural engineering, biomedical engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related quantitative field, or a Master's degree in one of these fields with 4+ years of relevant experience in a research-focused role.
* Substantial hands-on experience analyzing continuous neural time-series data, ideally field potentials such as ECoG, sEEG, LFP, or EEG.
* A strong foundation in neural signal processing, including filtering, spectral analysis (such as band power and time-frequency methods), artifact handling, and feature extraction.
* A solid applied machine learning background, including both supervised and unsupervised methods, particularly with noisy biological data.
* Demonstrated ability to independently frame scientific questions, select and defend appropriate methods, and carry analyses through to clear conclusions and actionable recommendations.
* Experience aligning neural recordings with behavioral and task data.
* Strong Python and scientific computing skills, with a track record of writing reusable, maintainable analysis code and using version control and sound data management practices.
* Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort working across scientific and engineering teams.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience with human intracranial recordings.
* Experience with motor decoding, cognitive-state decoding, or closed-loop BCI.
* Experience with video-based pose estimation or kinematic analysis.
* Experience building data pipelines or standards shared across studies.
* Experience with cloud-based data processing.

**How We Work**
---------------

* **We are intentional.** We prioritize and are thoughtful about how we use others' time.
* **We care for others.** We prioritize safety both for patients and one another.
* **We own outcomes, not just tasks.** Our work demands the highest standards because it impacts real patients and real lives.
* **Humility is a strength.** We are honest about what we know and what we don't know. Getting it right matters more than being right.

**Location**
------------

This role is based out of the San Francisco Bay Area and is expected to work on site from our Alameda headquarters at least 3 days a week.

**Benefits**
------------

Full-time employees are eligible for the following benefits:

* Competitive base salary with equity
* 100% of healthcare coverage for you and your dependents
* Generous vacation policy
* Paid parental leave
* Work from our waterfront office in Alameda, CA, with access to collaborative spaces and labs

Compensation Range: $140K - $165K

**Overview**
------------

**The team**
------------

Money Movement Risk AI/ML is a team of AI scientists and ML engineers in Intuit's Fintech Risk organization. Our models decide, in real time, whether money moves for small businesses on QuickBooks: card and ACH payments, money coming in, money going out, when funds are released, and how long a payment is held.

Every decision has two failure modes. Approve the wrong transaction and Intuit takes a fraud or credit loss. Decline or hold the right one and a small business waits for money it has already earned. Our job is to push both down at the same time.

Our mandate: **AI touches every money movement risk decision.** That covers deciding (authorize, fund, release), acting on the decision (queue, investigate, hold), and accounting for it (expected loss).

**The role**
------------

You will be the technical owner of one money movement risk capability: its models, its evaluation, its production health, and its business outcome. You will design, train, validate, and ship the models yourself, and you will set direction for the scientists and engineers who build with you.

This role is for an AI producer. You will build new models from first principles and put them in front of live money. It is not a role for wiring an existing LLM into a product surface.

**What you will work on**
-------------------------

Depending on fit and team needs, you will own one or more of these areas:

* **Authorization risk.** Real-time fraud and loss models that approve, decline, or step up card and ACH transactions, for both money coming in and money going out.
* **Funding and settlement risk.** Models that decide when funds are released and how long payments are held or delayed, so good customers get paid faster and risky payments are caught before money leaves.
* **Balance and account-level money risk.** Risk on stored balances and on the accounts behind them, as more money stays inside Intuit.
* **Day-1 risk for new money products.** Risk decisioning that is ready when a new payment or funding product launches, often with almost no labeled history.
* **Agentic money movement.** Transaction risk for payments and money actions initiated by AI agents and assistants: agent identity, consent, and intent.
* **Risk-ranked queueing.** Ranking cases for risk operations by dollars at risk, so analysts spend time where the loss is.

**Responsibilities**

**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Own outcomes, not just models.** Define success in loss, approval rate, hold rate, and time-to-funds. Ship models that move those numbers, and own them in production.
* **Solve the hard statistics of risk.** Delayed and noisy labels (chargebacks and returns arrive weeks later), extreme class imbalance, and selection bias from models whose decisions shape their own training data. Use holdouts, reject inference, and counterfactual evaluation to measure what actually happened.
* **Build for adaptive adversaries.** Detect fraud rings, account takeover, and new attack patterns with graph, sequence, and anomaly-detection methods. Test models against attackers who probe, retry, and adapt.
* **Make models production-grade.** Partner with ML engineers on real-time features, low-latency serving, automated retraining, and monitoring for drift, data quality, and loss.
* **Turn Intuit's data into an advantage.** Build reusable, versioned features and labels from transaction, account, and network data that other models on the team can build on.
* **Set the evaluation bar.** Establish offline and online evaluation, experimentation, and adversarial testing standards for your area.
* **Lead across functions.** Work with risk policy, product, engineering, risk operations, and finance. Explain trade-offs between loss and friction in plain terms and drive decisions.
* **Raise the team.** Mentor senior and early-career scientists and engineers, lead design and model reviews, and help hire.

**Qualifications**

**What you bring**
------------------

**Required**

* 8+ years building and deploying ML models in production, including significant work in fraud, payments, credit, or another adversarial or financial-risk domain.
* MS or PhD in Statistics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* A track record of owning models that made real-time, high-stakes decisions, with measured business impact.
* Deep expertise in gradient-boosted trees, deep learning, and anomaly detection, plus the statistics to validate them: calibration, imbalance, delayed labels, and selection bias.
* Strong Python and SQL, and hands-on large-scale feature engineering with Spark or similar.
* Experience shipping models with ML engineers: real-time features, serving, retraining, monitoring.
* Sound experimental judgment in a risk setting: A/B tests, holdouts, and their limits when attackers can exploit them.
* Clear communication with risk, product, and business leaders.

**Preferred**

* Payments risk experience: card and ACH authorization, funding, chargebacks, returns, or settlement.
* Graph ML or network analysis for fraud rings and collusion.
* Sequence or representation learning on transaction and behavioral data.
* Experience building or evaluating LLM and agentic systems, especially for risk or operations.
* Model risk management and explainability in a regulated financial-services environment.
* Experience leading a technical area across teams and mentoring scientists.

**Why join**
------------

* **Your work moves real money.** Your models decide whether small businesses get paid, and how fast.
* **Hard problems.** Millisecond decisions, adaptive attackers, labels that arrive weeks late, and models that shape their own training data.
* **Full ownership.** Scientists here own their models from problem framing to production. Nobody hands you a spec.
* **An AI-native risk org.** We are building toward AI making every money movement risk

ambiguous_jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

Intuit’s Identity Data Science Team is looking for a hands-on Senior Data Scientist who is a creative problem solver with a passion to deliver advanced data-driven solutions. You will work alongside other Data Scientists, Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, Architects, and Program Managers to evolve Intuit’s Identity capabilities within Intuit’s Platform. As a key member of the data science team, you will have a strong track record of combining advanced analytical skills with exceptional business and entrepreneurial acumen. You will also have an ownership mindset with a strong willingness to take on new challenges with enthusiasm.

This is an exciting time to join the Identity Data Science Team at Intuit as we are building many new cutting-edge capabilities. These include a next-generation Verified Identity Network, password-less authentication powered through passkeys, Generative AI experiences, modern and sophisticated fraud prevention, centralized user and account management, and much more. Data is central to Intuit’s decision-making process, and data scientists are a critical component to evangelize data-driven decisions as we transform and scale Identity capabilities to power Intuit’s future growth.

**Responsibilities**

* Partner with cross functional teams to drive data-backed decisions and actionable insights
* Use a hypothesis-driven approach to drive design, implementation, and analysis of A/B experiments. Then provide executive level recommendations on next steps based on the test results and insights
* Communicate analytical findings and recommendations in a clear and concise way to non-technical audiences, both in writing and through oral presentations
* Provide guidance and thought leadership to business leaders and stakeholders on how best to harness available data to support business goals
* Ensure data collection and data processing is optimized to provide crystal-clear visibility into the impact and value of new initiatives and product releases
* Identify opportunities for developing new data sources, and provide technical leadership around making those data sources high-quality and broadly available
* Pursue data quality, troubleshoot data anomalies, validate data accuracy, and drive issues to resolution
* Share responsibility for owning and maintaining the data science backlog, connecting directly with partners and stakeholders to communicate and align on priorities

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience working in web, marketing, product, analytics, or other related data science fields with a strong knowledge of statistics
* Exceptional SQL skills and experience working with granular web and native clickstream data
* Highly proficient in Tableau, Qliksense, Quicksight or similar software
* Exceptional ability to take initiative, be a self-starter, and solve problems
* Outstanding communications skills with the ability to influence decision makers and build consensus with stakeholder teams
* Proactive and inquisitive learner who seeks out and capitalizes on opportunities for change that enhance the business, rather than reacting to circumstances
* Strong organizational skills, time management, accountability, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously to meet objectives and key deadlines
* Love for mentoring and guiding others on best practices. Passionate about the advancement of the whole team
* Experience in programming languages, automation tools, and stats packages (e.g. Python) is a plus; comfortable creating re-usable data pipelines

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

The expected base pay range for this position is:
  
San Diego $149,500 - $202,500
